summary: Helsingin Sanomat's campaign page for the free Climate Crisis Font, whose weight axis is labelled in years (1979→2050) and mapped to real and forecast Arctic sea-ice extent, so letters thin and break apart as the ice shrinks. A stack of full-screen black, white and grey sections, mostly over video: a melting title, the data chart behind the axis, an animated timeline, a parallax 'CLIMATE CHANGE ISN'T REAL' wall, the 1979 vs 2050 alphabets, newspaper use cases, a year-slider tester and an OFL download with a press kit.

instances.look: Fixed transparent top bar: black 'HELSINGIN SANOMAT' logo tag at the left (HS monogram on mobile), a globe 'FI' language link and a small white 'Free download' button at the right; repeated over every section

Full-screen looping aerial video of broken sea ice in slate blue-grey; centred 'CLIMATE CRISIS FONT' in three white lines that keep melting from solid heavy caps into thin, fractured shapes and back, 'Type to Act.' below in serif, a white 'Free Download' button and an outlined 'Play video' button, a mouse-scroll indicator at the bottom
instances.ux: The title's weight animates through the year axis on a loop (CSS keyframes 'header_melt'); 'Play video' opens a Vimeo film in a lightbox; Free Download jumps to the download section
instances.learn: Animate the title across an axis that carries meaning (years of ice loss): the motion itself states the message before any copy

instances.look: On black: 'BASED ON REAL ARCTIC SEA ICE DATA', a line chart of ice extent at 1979, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2019, 2030, 2040, 2050 whose rows of 'CLIMATE CHANGE' get thinner and more broken at each year, a source paragraph, and a looping video of a big 'A' stepping through the eight year-instances with year tags; then on light graph paper the word 'CLIMATE CRISIS' with each letter one year further along a ruled timeline, grey ice-floe silhouettes shrinking above it

instances.learn: Plot the axis against its data source: the chart, the stepped glyph and the timeline all say 'weight = sea ice', so the variable axis becomes a data visualisation
